experiment: story-2 30-40 s / ~92 words; spoken hook names Wirtz + Klopp + 5-0, payoff ~1.5 s; beat 1 starts on 'Paraguay' (no case-file preamble); question at ~20 s

beats.say: Klopp's Germany, five-nil. Two goals: Florian Wirtz.
beats.caption: Klopp's Germany, 5-0. Two goals: Florian Wirtz.

beats.say: Paraguay. Five months ago, they knocked Germany out of the World Cup. Then Klopp replaced Nagelsmann.
beats.caption: Paraguay. Five months ago, they knocked Germany out of the World Cup. Then Klopp replaced Nagelsmann.

card.sub: round of 32 · Jürgen Klopp then replaced Julian Nagelsmann

beats.say: Klopp: the new coach would have to drink himself into a stupor to look at them. Then? Love at first sight.
beats.caption: Klopp: the new coach would have to drink himself into a stupor to look at them. Then? Love at first sight.

card.text:
…DRINK HIMSELF INTO A STUPOR…
BUT THEN I ARRIVED, AND IT WAS
*LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT.*

beats.say: Liverpool paid a club-record hundred and sixteen million. Can he bring this form back?
beats.caption: Liverpool paid a club-record £116m. Can he bring this form back?

beats.say: On the hour, Wirtz wins it off Dumfries, fires in from outside the box. Then a second.
beats.caption: On the hour, Wirtz wins it off Dumfries, fires in from outside the box. Then a second.

card.sub: won the ball from Netherlands captain Denzel Dumfries · second from a Brajan Gruda cut-back

beats.say: Group winners. Klopp: no-one will be questioning them for three or four months. Follow for the next Scout File.
beats.caption: Group winners. Klopp: no-one will be questioning them for three or four months. Follow for the next Scout File.

card.sub: Germany into the Nations League quarter-finals as group winners
